experiment_description: Combines seasonal residual learning, long-window MLP compression and the reduced HMM feature design.
model_intro_cn: 组合消融模型：同时采用季节残差、长期MLP压缩和精简HMM特征。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: B1 residual structure with causal HMM posterior and state features as ordinary inputs, without the HMM gate or state-conditioned attention.
model_intro_cn: 简化HMM辅助模型：将HMM概率与状态统计作为输入，但不使用复杂门控和状态注意力。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: LightGBM base forecast plus an HMM-guided deep network trained to predict its regression residual; classification probabilities are blended.
model_intro_cn: 树模型与深度残差融合：LightGBM提供基础预测，HMM辅助深度网络学习其回归残差并融合分类概率。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: B5 regression correction multiplied by the residual shrinkage coefficient selected on validation data.
model_intro_cn: B5残差收缩版本：验证集选择残差缩放系数，避免深度修正破坏LightGBM回归结果。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: B0 structure trained to correct a 24-hour seasonal-naive forecast through a learned residual.
model_intro_cn: 季节残差模型：以季节朴素预测为基础，仅学习未来24小时碳强度修正量并联合分类。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Replaces the 168-hour recurrent branch with an MLP-compressed long-window representation while retaining HMM guidance.
model_intro_cn: 长期压缩消融：用MLP压缩168小时静态信息，替代长期循环分支。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Multi-scale HMM-MRGA-LSTM using the reduced causal HMM feature set.
model_intro_cn: 精简HMM特征消融：保留多尺度LSTM，只使用缩减后的因果HMM特征。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Original HMM-MRGA-LSTM with 24h/168h multi-scale inputs, HMM gate, state-conditioned attention and residual head.
model_intro_cn: 原始HMM-MRGA-LSTM：融合24/168小时输入、HMM门控、状态条件注意力和残差预测头。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: LightGBM 提供基线 logit，多尺度 HMM 辅助 LSTM 只学习样本外基线遗漏的 delta_logit。
model_intro_cn: 对数几率残差分类模型：LightGBM给出基线logit，多尺度HMM辅助LSTM只学习delta_logit修正。
task_type: 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: 对 LGBM-LR-LSTM 的最终概率再用独立验证集进行 Platt 校准。
model_intro_cn: 残差分类后校准模型：对LGBM-LR-LSTM输出再做Platt校准，提高风险概率可信度。
task_type: 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: LightGBM predicts the 24-hour carbon trajectory and high-carbon transition probability from tabular lag and rolling features.
model_intro_cn: LightGBM多任务基线：用滞后与日历表格特征预测未来24小时碳强度及高碳跃迁概率。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Random Forest regression and balanced classification models trained on the same tabular features and time split as LightGBM.
model_intro_cn: 随机森林基线：用多棵决策树完成多步回归和类别平衡的高碳风险分类。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: XGBoost regression and classification models trained on the same tabular features and time split as LightGBM.
model_intro_cn: XGBoost机器学习基线：使用与LightGBM相同的数据切分和表格特征完成回归与分类。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Multi-scale seasonal-residual LSTM without HMM information; control model for B8 and B9.
model_intro_cn: 无HMM对照：保留多尺度残差LSTM，但完全不输入HMM信息。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: B7 plus causal HMM posterior probabilities concatenated to the neural representation.
model_intro_cn: HMM概率拼接模型：将因果HMM后验概率直接拼接到多尺度LSTM表示。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: 在独立验证集上用单调分段函数校准 LightGBM 的分类 logit。
model_intro_cn: 概率校准模型：在验证集上用单调分段函数校准LightGBM分类概率，拟合能力更灵活。
task_type: 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: 在独立验证集上用 Sigmoid 校准 LightGBM 的分类 logit，测试集不参与校准。
model_intro_cn: 概率校准模型：在验证集上用Sigmoid函数校准LightGBM分类概率，不改变样本排序。
task_type: 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: B4 classification-only predictions after validation-based probability direction and threshold checking.
model_intro_cn: 分类概率方向检查：验证B4分类概率是否需要翻转，并使用验证集选择阈值。
task_type: 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: B4 regression-only predictions after validation-based probability direction and threshold checking.
model_intro_cn: 回归解耦方向检查：保留B4回归结果，用于记录分类概率方向诊断，不作为分类模型。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测

experiment_description: Uses causal HMM probabilities to mix state-specific LSTM transitions instead of treating HMM probabilities as ordinary inputs.
model_intro_cn: Markovian状态混合模型：用上一时刻HMM概率加权多个状态专属LSTM转移。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Ridge predicts the continuous 24-hour trajectory and balanced Logistic Regression predicts the high-carbon transition on the same samples.
model_intro_cn: 统计学习基线：Ridge负责连续值预测，平衡逻辑回归负责高碳风险分类。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Classification-only training of the legacy multi-scale HMM-MRGA-LSTM; regression is not jointly optimized.
model_intro_cn: 分类解耦实验：仅优化高碳跃迁分类，不报告未训练回归头的预测指标。
task_type: 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Regression-only training of the legacy multi-scale HMM-MRGA-LSTM; the original probability output is retained for diagnosis.
model_intro_cn: 回归解耦实验：仅优化未来24小时碳强度预测，不评价未训练分类头。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测

experiment_description: Same predictions as B1, with the classification threshold selected on validation data.
model_intro_cn: B1阈值实验：回归预测与B1相同，分类阈值由验证集精确选择。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Same predictions as B3, with the classification threshold selected on validation data.
model_intro_cn: B3阈值实验：模型概率与B3相同，分类阈值由验证集精确选择。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Optimized B5 regression output with probability direction and classification threshold selected on validation data.
model_intro_cn: B5阈值版本：采用优化后的B5回归结果，并为分类概率选择验证集最佳阈值。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测 + 高碳风险分类

experiment_description: Uses the carbon intensity observed 24 hours earlier as the full 24-hour forecast; no learned model or HMM.
model_intro_cn: 季节朴素预测基线：直接用历史周期值预测未来碳强度，不训练机器学习模型。
task_type: 多步碳强度预测
